name: Senbayashi Ayano
source:
She is the granddaughter of the chairman of the Senbayashi Group—a so-called “rich girl.”
She has been involved in development for the body care products division and has brought numerous products to market—which she helped develop and designed the packaging for—earning quite high praise.
She occasionally appears on television and is famous for her beauty and great figure.
Having grown up in a somewhat unique environment, she dislikes conflict and has a gentle disposition. She is approachable and kind to everyone, though some might say she’s a people-pleaser.
She is somewhat naive and lacks worldly wisdom and occasionally hurts or angers others without meaning to. It’s not uncommon for people to whisper behind her back, calling her a “hypocrite.”
Due to a minor incident, she catches Renji’s attention.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110528010142/http://www.turumiku.jp/osaka/ayano.html]official site[/url]]
